overview: The Medford City Council and Community Development Board convened a joint meeting to restart the zoning update process for Medford Square following a 2025 project pause. The bodies established procedural rules for joint sessions and reviewed revised proposals for a new Medford Square mixed-use district focused on height incentives and boundary modifications.

items.title: Joint Session Procedural Rules (26-022)
items.summary: Approved a resolution adopting rules for joint meetings between the City Council and Community Development Board, aligning procedures with those used in joint sessions with the School Committee.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Ordinance Amendments (26-023)
items.summary: Opened a public hearing on proposed amendments to Chapter 94 to create a Medford Square District featuring mixed-use sub-districts with height incentives up to nine stories in specific areas. Discussion centered on balancing development urgency with historic preservation, the efficacy of parking minimums in a walkable square, and the impact of residential density on local businesses. The hearing was continued to February 25, 2026, to allow for further board deliberation and community engagement.
